    Projects & Industry Experience

    This page collects the applied projects and workstreams highlighted in my research CV.

    Alibaba · 2026.05 – 2026.09

    Agent Harness 驱动的多模态质量诊断与自进化

    Algorithm Engineer · Multimodal, Taobao Tmall Group / China E-commerce Business Group.

    Built trajectory compression, evidence routing, and Attribution/Critic/Counterfactual Grader rubrics for 300+ node Agent chains. Batch verification reached nearly 95% high-value case reduction and moved end-to-end diagnosis from tens of minutes to the minute scale. Also developed a severity-aware SOP alignment and fine-tuning loop with SFT samples and graded rewards.

    China Telecom · 2025.09 – 2026.05

    数据基础设施与安全事业部 · 算法开发

    Built a rule/Agent dual-path cleaning system for network-security assets, then designed fragment-indexing and semantic/fine-grained matching algorithms for asset-vulnerability retrieval. The work improved search logic, recall quality, coverage, and pipeline maintainability.

    Huawei Collaboration · Vector Search

    华为通用向量检索合作项目

    Core contributor to hybrid vector retrieval and the STABLE project. The collaboration received the Huawei Outstanding Technical Collaboration Award and is connected to the industrialization of high-throughput heterogeneous vector search.

    Research Skills

    • Agent and feedback loops: Agent Harness, trajectory/trace compression, evidence routing, Grader/Rubric, Critic, self-play, SFT/DPO/RLVR, Skill/Memory.
    • Multimodal and retrieval: MLLM task modeling, composed image retrieval, vision-language representation, ANN, hybrid metrics, heterogeneous indexes, dynamic routing.
    • Trustworthy AI: AIGC generation and detection, artifact elimination, AI watermarking, safety evaluation, data cleaning, index construction, and batch evaluation.
